body: What is the media tag and how do you get it?

title: [Question] Media Tag

replies.author: voidloop
replies.body:
It's the streamers of the tournament

Contact Administrafer in game or via skype.

replies.author: faht
replies.body:
Media is someone who is streaming/recording avicus events, such as tournaments.

Contact Jozz (Administrafer) in game or via skype, which Troekiu mentioned ^

replies.author: vladthegreat100
replies.body: It's not the youtuber/VIP rank, it's the media rank. As long as you have good quality recording/editing or you can stream with good quality (probably least 720p) and barely to no lag/choppyness than you should be good

replies.author: vladthegreat100
replies.body: Also do keep in mind that you will need to be dedicated because one you record the tournament it's usually not an easy upload of just adding music to it but to cut the video down to only the best parts to make a highlight as not usually anyone would watch a recorded tournament round. Also good amount of space on your computer as a tournament round can go up to 1 hour long.
